longDescription: Frank Baum is a fantasy novel written during the late 19th century. The story continues the adventures of Dorothy Gale, who, along with new companions such as Zebediah and Eureka the kitten, finds herself ensnared in yet another extraordinary journey through the magical land of Oz.
